name: ColorNote Backup Import
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Imports local ColorNote version 7.1 backups into a new folder.
Converts checklist marks and retains source metadata.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Checklist lines marked [V] in ColorNote become checked tasks, and [ ] lines become open tasks.
The import report lists skipped records, such as locked, archive and trash notes, with their source IDs.
tip: With Pro, save a profile that maps color indexes to names such as Yellow. Imported notes then get a color_label property.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. ColorNote Backup Import is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for moving your notes into Obsidian with it.
